feature: 3D rotation grippers on a picked layer
summary: Picking a layer with the Select tool now shows its 3D grippers straight away: the green swing arc and red tip arc on the turn knob and the blue depth arrow off its middle. No resting on the knob first.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/3d-grippers-on-a-picked-layer-walk.json.

try.do: Open a recording, add a title, press V and click the title.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Move the pointer away: the arcs and the arrow stay.
Drag the green flat arc sideways to swing the title.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Draw a small rectangle and pick it: it wears the same grippers.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag its top right corner: it resizes, even though the depth arrow passes over it.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Pick a marked-up screenshot layer and check the grippers do not get in the way of moving it.

evaluate: Are these the grippers you had in mind, in the place you expected them?
On a small layer, do the arcs and arrow feel too busy around the box?
On a screenshot you are redlining, is having the arcs and the arrow always out acceptable, or do you want a way to hide them?
Does grabbing a small layer near its middle still move it the way you expect?
rough: The mock's Depth page (option A) brings the arcs out only while the pointer rests on the knob; they now show as soon as the layer is picked, your call on 2026-10-13.
The depth arrow and the pivot crosshair are now on every picked layer, screenshots included, as the mock's Depth page draws them for all three options.

On a layer about 40 points across, the depth arrow covers much of its upper right quarter: a press there pushes it in depth instead of moving it. Resize squares and the knob keep their presses; the body does not.
On a small layer the swing arc's right arrowhead and the depth arrow's head sit close together; a press goes to whichever is nearer.
